title: Refresh the packaged async score processor Lambda base image

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Investigation confirmed the packaged runtime pins an older Lambda Python base image. Production image scanning identified high-severity operating-system findings inherited from that base. Remediation will refresh the immutable upstream base digest, retain deterministic pinning, validate the packaged Dockerfile contract, and avoid changes to downstream deployment code.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Updated both stages of the packaged async score processor Dockerfile to the current immutable AWS Lambda Python 3.12 base manifest. Added a runtime contract assertion that both stages use that approved digest. Validation passed: python -m pytest tests/runtime/test_async_score_processor_runtime.py infrastructure/score_processor_artifacts/tests/unit/test_score_processor_artifact_pipeline_stack.py -q (10 passed).

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: The refreshed immutable Lambda Python 3.12 base-image pin and its Dockerfile contract test were merged to develop in PR #583. Targeted runtime and artifact-pipeline tests passed before merge.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Correction: PR #583 remains open in GitHub and its commit is not yet contained by develop. The task has been returned to in progress; downstream pinning will begin only after the merge is visible on develop.
